Package model

Class Character

java.lang.Object
model.Entity
model.Character
Direct Known Subclasses:
Enemy, NPC, Player
public abstract class Character extends Entity
The abstract class for a character. From it, the player, npc and enemies inherit the basic common fields and methods.

  • Constructor Details

    • Character

      public Character(String id, int x, int y, String name, int characterSpeed)
      Creates a character. It only initializes the basic fields required for placement and identification
      Parameters:
      id - an id to identify the character
      x - the position on the x axis
      y - the position on the y axis
      name - the character's name (e.g. "slime")
      characterSpeed - the character's movement speed

  • Method Details

    • translate

      public void translate(int deltaX, int deltaY)
      Calculates the amount of space to move. When used without move, it allows knockback while keeping the facing direction.
      Parameters:
      deltaX - the change in the x axis
      deltaY - the change in the y axis
